title: Day of the Tiles
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Day of the Tiles", at revision 1371283602, opens: "The Day of the Tiles was an event that took place in the French town of Grenoble on 7 June 1788. It was one of the first disturbances preceding the French Revolution and is credited by a few historians as its start." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q200749, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Event of popular unrest in Grenoble, France". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
